newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firmer on the back of crude.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firmer on the back of crude.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were quoted higher on Monday amid strong crude values, traders said.
Bunker prices slid last week after weak demand forced suppliers to lower offers.
"But I don't see prices coming off further because crude is quite strong and other ports are moving up their prices," said one trader. "Prices here should be stronger than last week."
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $103-106 per tonne and 380-cst at $94-99, about $2-$3 higher from Friday. MDO and gas oil stabilised at around $195-$205 and $210-$220 respectively.
